areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Photovoltaic system in the requalified beach kiosks for cost savings and supply security.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Individual sewage collection and treatment system giving adequate final destination to kiosk wastewater.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Social work project ensures community participation, communication and environmental education during works, with a relocation and compensation plan for local traders.

areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Solar generation and sewage treatment have only indirect environmental effects, not actions directly aimed at sustainability.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Sewage works help water and soil conservation but the program has no integrated water-resources management actions.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: No actions directly aimed at biodiversity or forest management; benefits are indirect.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Information provided judged insufficient to score.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Entrepreneurship training could not be linked to concrete benefits such as simpler business opening or easier trade.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Insufficient information; kiosk requalification and training were not shown to generate jobs and income for vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: No infrastructure or facilities specifically aimed at low-income or vulnerable populations.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Training for women and youth judged insufficient here; such actions belong under criterion 1.11.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Training with quotas for women and youth not regarded as an effective inclusion action compared with, for example, hiring in works.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Better bathing-water quality is only an indirect health effect, not a specific health action.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Solar panels are equipment acquisition, already credited under 1.2, not technological innovation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Proponent's statements on private participation were insufficient to score.
